premises.text: Employers cannot efficiently find the few relevant candidates among hundreds of applications
premises.evidence_span: how do I find the 10 out of those 300 that matter to me

premises.text: Job seekers need to get noticed and know when applications are viewed and how employers respond
premises.evidence_span: As a job seeker, I also want to know what my application's viewed. I also want to know what the employer thought of me

premises.text: Uniform handpicked full-time job listings exclude scams and MLM
premises.evidence_span: all of the jobs are listed the same. We have a uniform format, and we handpick every single job

premises.text: Pay-to-apply plus employer feedback and view transparency make seekers worth noticing
premises.evidence_span: job seekers pay to apply on LocalBacon. And they notice that. In addition, employers and recruiters agree to give feedback

premises.text: Job credits from $0.99 with bulk discounts are the paid-apply currency
premises.evidence_span: you can purchase job credits. This is basically a virtual currency for our site

premises.text: Employer tools stay familiar while flagging to ATS and shelving with seeker notification
premises.evidence_span: as an employer, I gain credibility for giving transparency to my process without changing my behavior of handling candidates

domains.name: Curated marketplace with paid apply and employer tools

value.text: Quality matching and transparency for job seekers and employers
value.evidence_span: solve the fundamental problems that exist for both job seekers and employers

causal_links.evidence_span: Those three words evoke a bad taste in the mouth of both job seekers and employers
This is quality jobs for our quality candidates

notes: Pay-to-apply and feedback bundled as one commercial-transparency condition (could fail together as the seeker value proposition). Singleton D3 for credits pricing. iPaper and Ajax UI folded into marketplace product.

meta.provenance_note: Codebook-only prompt v1.3.2; temperature not API-controlled in this harness.
